falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day within the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A break below the August 2024 low equivalent (adjusted) would invalidate the 77% bottom pattern match, proving this was not a bottom formation but rather a continuation pattern

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Sustained elevated fear would contradict the blowoff score of 38 (which suggests exhaustion selling), indicating instead that panic is accelerating and the market has not found a floor

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury yield curve inverts by more than -50 basis points (i.e., 2Y yield exceeds 10Y yield by 0.50% or more)
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Deepening inversion would signal worsening recession probability, invalidating any 'bottom' thesis by confirming economic deterioration rather than a tradable low

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
